column3: wait() is deprecated: it is throttled, imprecise and can resume late.

column3: spawn() is deprecated: it delays the start by a frame or more and is replaced by the task library.
column5: 02 Luau Scripting/Task Library Coroutines and Yielding.md

column3: delay() is deprecated legacy scheduler API.
column5: 02 Luau Scripting/Task Library Coroutines and Yielding.md

column3: Instance.new(class, parent) parents before properties are set, so every later property change replicates separately and listeners see a half-built object.
column4: Call Instance.new(class), set the properties, then set .Parent last.

column3: Remote handler uses client-sent arguments without a visible runtime check (heuristic). Luau type annotations are not enforced at runtime.
column4: Check each argument with typeof()/type() (plus range, ownership and rate) at the top of the handler and return early on failure.
column5: 03 Architecture and Networking/Server Authority and Validation.md

column3: Server calls RemoteFunction:InvokeClient: a client that never answers or leaves hangs the server thread, and an exploiter can return anything or error.
column4: Use a RemoteEvent request/response with a timeout instead of waiting on a client answer.
column5: 03 Architecture and Networking/RemoteEvents RemoteFunctions and Unreliable Remotes.md

column3: DataStore/web ...Async call is not inside pcall: throttling or an outage throws and kills the thread (lost saves, players stuck loading).
column4: Wrap it in pcall with retry and backoff, check the success flag, and never save over data that failed to load.

column3: SetAsync on player data overwrites blindly: a stale server or a failed load can wipe newer progress.
column4: Use UpdateAsync (read-modify-write with a session or version check) or a session-locked profile library.
column5: 04 Data and Persistence/Session Locking and Profile Libraries.md

column3: This file saves on PlayerRemoving but never calls game:BindToClose, so the last changes are lost when the server shuts down.
column4: Add game:BindToClose that saves every remaining player (in parallel) before the server closes.
column5: 04 Data and Persistence/Saving Correctly - Autosave and BindToClose.md

column3: ProcessReceipt does not return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision correctly.
column4: Return PurchaseGranted only after the grant is saved; return NotProcessedYet on any failure or when the player is gone.
column5: 11 Monetization Publishing and Live Ops/Developer Products and ProcessReceipt.md

column3: ProcessReceipt never records receiptInfo.PurchaseId: Roblox retries receipts, so a retry can grant the product twice.
column4: Store processed PurchaseIds in the player's saved data (UpdateAsync or profile) and skip ones already granted.
column5: 04 Data and Persistence/Purchase Data and Receipts.md

column3: ProcessReceipt changes a value before any save is confirmed (heuristic): if the save fails the player keeps the item and the receipt is retried.
column4: Save first (UpdateAsync recording the PurchaseId), then apply the in-game grant, then return PurchaseGranted.
column5: 04 Data and Persistence/Purchase Data and Receipts.md

column3: File mixes MarketplaceService purchases with random rolls but never checks PolicyService (heuristic): paid random items must honour ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted and show odds before purchase.
column4: On the server, pcall PolicyService:GetPolicyInfoForPlayerAsync, fail closed, offer a compliant alternative when restricted, and display odds that sum to 100%.
column5: 11 Monetization Publishing and Live Ops/Paid Random Items and Odds Disclosure in Practice.md

column3: :Connect inside a repeating loop or per-frame handler without cleanup: every pass adds another connection (memory leak, handler firing many times).
column4: Connect once outside the loop, use :Once, or keep the connection and :Disconnect() it (Janitor/Maid/Trove).

column3: Infinite loop with no yield and no break: it freezes the server or client.
column4: Add task.wait() (or wait on an event), or replace the polling loop with a signal or RunService connection.
column5: 02 Luau Scripting/Task Library Coroutines and Yielding.md

column3: Client script sets a currency/leaderstats value: client changes never reach the server, and only the server may own currency.
column4: Fire a remote asking the server; the server validates, changes the value and saves it.
column5: 22 Anti-Exploit and Security/How Exploits Work - The Client Boundary.md

column3: FindFirstChild result is indexed immediately; it returns nil when the child is missing ("attempt to index nil").
column4: Store the result and check it (local x = p:FindFirstChild("X") if x then ... end), or use WaitForChild when it must exist.
